name: MC-series star cruiser
description: The MC-series star cruiser, or simply the Mon Calamari cruiser, was a series of starships that were produced by Mon Calamari Shipyards. The ships were known for their organic-looking, bulbous shape. Many MC-series Star Cruisers were used as part of the Rebel Alliance, and were their main capital ships. After the Battle of Yavin, Han Solo, Leia Organa and Luke Skywalker went to Mon Cala to convince the Mon Calamari to donate their fleet to the rebel cause. After seeing the broadcast of the death of their king, the Mon Calamari mutinied against the Galactic Empire and joined the Rebel Alliance. During the Battle of Endor, the Rebel Alliance fielded a number of similar Mon Calamari cruisers to Home One in an attempt to conceal the identity of Admiral Gial Ackbar's command ship.
